title: SPH sculpt
description: An island of plasticine you dig and build on, ray traced in compute through an 8-bit distance field with seven mips. The kit's lighting shades it with soft wrapped light, cone-traced shadows and occlusion under a golden-hour sky baked into an environment, and FXAA smooths its edges. A spring feeds SPH water, sorted into the kit's neighbour grid each step. Only the grid's blocks near water rebuild the surface the rays meet.
line: Dig channels in clay and watch water from a spring flow downhill.
hint: drag to dig · hold Shift to build · right-drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
